meta.promptText: Mujhe India mein 3000 rupees ke andar running shoes kharidne hain. Konse lene chahiye?

response.text:
India mein **₹3000 ke andar** running shoes lene ke liye, *daily running / beginner use* ke liye sabse safe picks ye rahenge: **Nike Run Defy**, **Skechers Go Run Consistent**, **Puma Voltaic Evo**, **ASICS Patriot 13 / Jolt 5**, aur **adidas Duramo SL / Duramo SL 2**.[1][2][12]

Agar **sirf ek best overall** choose karna ho, to **Nike Run Defy** ko strongest all-round pick maana gaya hai, kyunki ye lightweight hai, soft foam cushioning deta hai, aur under-₹3000 segment mein balanced option hai.[2][12]  
Agar aapko **zyada cushioning** chahiye, to **Skechers Go Run Consistent** accha option hai.[2]  
Agar aap **mainly running performance** chahte hain aur thoda stable ride prefer karte hain, to **Puma Voltaic Evo** ko better running-focused pick bataya gaya hai.[12]

**Mere practical recommendations:**

- **Best overall:** Nike Run Defy[2][12]
- **Best cushioning:** Skechers Go Run Consistent[2]
- **Best running-focused:** Puma Voltaic Evo[12]
- **Reliable beginner options:** ASICS Patriot 13, ASICS Jolt 5[1]
- **Good mainstream budget picks:** adidas Duramo SL, adidas Duramo SL 2[1]

**Kaun sa lena chahiye, aapke use ke hisaab se:**
- **3–5 km daily runs:** Nike Run Defy ya ASICS Patriot 13[1][2]
- **Heavy runner / heel strike:** Skechers Go Run Consistent[2]
- **Running + gym + casual use:** Puma Voltaic Evo ya adidas Duramo SL[1][12]
- **ASICS brand preference:** Jolt 5 / Patriot 13[1]

**Buy karte time ye 4 cheezein check karna:**
- **Fit:** toe box mein halka space ho
- **Cushioning:** heel par jhatka absorb ho
- **Outsole grip:** Indian roads ke liye rubber sole better hota hai
- **Sale price:** in models ka best value usually discount mein milta hai, MRP par nahi[1][2]

Agar aap chahein, main aapke liye **men’s / women’s**, **wide feet**, ya **5 km daily run** ke hisaab se **top 3 exact options** short-list kar deta hoon.
